title: TokenUsage
description: What one call to a model cost: who made it, which model answered, how many tokens each way, and the money. Separate from the credit ledger — credits are what the customer is charged, tokens are what the call actually consumed, and the two move for different reasons.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

person.description: The wallet, handle, or id under localIds of whoever the call was made for. Absent for a call nobody is signed in behind, such as a background pass.

session.description: The work session the call belongs to, as the system that owns the session names it. Absent when it belongs to none.

job.description: The id of the job that made the call, in the system that owns jobs.

provider.description: Who served the call. Free text: providers are added without the shape changing.

model.description: The model name as the provider gives it, verbatim. Kept exactly because the price was read against this string.

callType.description: What the call was for, in the words of the system that made it. Free text: the kinds of call belong to that system.

costUsd.description: What the call cost in US dollars, worked out when it was written from the prices in force then. Recorded rather than recomputed: prices change, and what was spent does not.
